HHH-21221: Preserve IDENTITY-generated identifiers on temporal updates.

Single-table replacement inserts bind the existing ID, use the canonical graph table descriptors and avoid the identity-only delegate. The collector excludes the existing simple ID when an arbitrary-value delegate is needed for other values. History-table inserts copy the existing key and mark the history table as auxiliary to avoid the identifier-table batching assertion. Ordinary identity insertion stays on its existing path.

The reporter’s two regressions failed on unchanged main 0a6ed12 with the expected ClassCastException and canBeBatched assertion (H2 #140, 44882193733). Both passed on 8e422d35; the focused H2 temporal package ran 413 tests, 407 passed and 6 skipped, and hibernate-core formatChecks passed (#141, 44882727219). Artifact confirmed the tested source tree 95d93a549b040254a367c217b21e31451d4d2dc1 was unchanged. No full dialect matrix run for this handoff; a generated non-ID property case is not covered by the reporter fixture.
